# Word lists used for word types (nouns, verbs, adjectives, adverbs)

`en.tsv.gz` and `es.tsv.gz` map every known word form to all the word classes it can have (classes that are rare uses of that word, under 5% in the treebanks, are marked with `?`). They are
generated by `tools/build-lexicon.py` from:

| Data | Used for | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| English Speller Database (ESDB / SCOWL v2) by Kevin Atkinson, https://github.com/en-wl/wordlist | English word forms, parts of speech and all inflections (including irregular verbs) | Permissive, see `LICENSE-ESDB-SCOWL.txt` |
| FreeLing Spanish dictionary (Spanish Resource Grammar, IULA, Universitat Pompeu Fabra), https://github.com/TALP-UPC/FreeLing | Spanish word forms and every verb conjugation | LGPL for Linguistic Resources, see `LICENSE-FreeLing-Spanish-LGPLLR.txt` |
| Universal Dependencies English EWT treebank | How common each use of an ambiguous English word is | CC BY-SA 4.0 |
| Universal Dependencies Spanish AnCora and GSD treebanks | How common each use of an ambiguous Spanish word is | CC BY 4.0 (AnCora), CC BY-SA 4.0 (GSD) |

The derived files `en.tsv.gz` and `es.tsv.gz` are shared under the same terms
(CC BY-SA 4.0 for the frequency information they contain).
